conclusions: A freshly created distinct session receives NO_DATA when no native rollback is active, or permission denied for a foreign active rollback. It must never confirm the older task.
Cleanup retains the existing file/token/journal/hash/symlink/extra-child validations and only unlinks recognized files. No recursive deletion or settings replay.
Persistent receipts contain only pinned identity, bounded paths/tokens and file/config hashes; no passwords or file contents.
Previously owned untracked directories need a fresh successfully verified policy snapshot before automatic adoption. A login alone does not accept an uncertain configuration.
Receipt-based known restoration or a matching verified snapshot is rechecked on login. Unknown, changed and unowned directories remain retained with reason codes.
Common Python business logic is shared on Windows and Debian. No new GUI widget, OS-specific API, package dependency or recurring timer.

behavior_limits: Existing directories without PC receipts are only adopted after a fresh fully verified initialization with matching file hashes. A login alone does not declare an uncertain legacy operation successful.
